_agentNote: Categories mirror the four pieces of gear in a working indoor BSF rig (light + cage + bin + ramp) plus consumables and reading. Keep this list short and operationally meaningful — the audience is people building a real setup, not browsing.

categories.name: Indoor BSF Starter Kits
categories.description: Complete love-cage + light + bin + ramp bundles to start a colony from scratch.

categories.name: Mating Lights
categories.description: Quartz halogen worklights, UVA/UVB reptile bulbs, and LED+UV combos that trigger indoor copulation.

categories.name: Love Cages & Adult Enclosures
categories.description: Mesh enclosures sized and ventilated for adult black soldier flies.

categories.name: Larvae Bins & Self-Harvest Ramps
categories.description: Bins, ramps, and migration channels for active larvae and passive prepupae harvest.

categories.name: Feedstock & Substrate
categories.description: Bedding (aspen, coco coir), oviposition media, and starter feed when food scraps aren't enough.

categories.name: Temperature, Humidity & Light Meters

categories.name: Books & Research
